$description: Voneo's colour palette, shared by the web app and the mobile app. The web app reads it through a Tailwind plugin (web-server/src/src/styles/colors-plugin.mjs) and the mobile app imports it directly (mobile-app/src/theme/theme.ts). Contrast ratios are WCAG, against the surface each colour is used on.

surface.use: Cards, video tiles, fields placed directly on the canvas

surface-raised.use: Fields inside cards, tab bars, icon circles, hover on surface

surface-active.use: Selected tab, avatars, secondary icon buttons

line.use: Decorative dividers and card edges (not a control boundary)

line-control.use: Borders of inputs and outline controls: 3.1:1 on surface-raised, 3.7:1 on surface

ink.use: Body text and headings: 16.1:1 or better

ink-soft.use: Less prominent labels (sender names, badges): 13.5:1 on canvas

ink-muted.use: Secondary text and placeholders: 5.8:1 or better, up to surface-raised

focus.use: Keyboard focus rings: 5.8:1 or better, up to surface-raised

danger.use: Errors and hang up: 5.4:1 or better, up to surface-raised
